description: Verify two scientific claims against real abstracts: one is supported, one is contradicted, and one paper is unrelated. Cite the evidence for each verdict.
task_prompt:
Two claims are under review.
Claim 1: Tirasemtiv has no effect on fast-twitch muscle.
Claim 2: Foxk2 regulates autophagy genes in muscle cells and fibroblast cells.
Using the papers in documents/, decide for each claim whether the evidence supports it, contradicts it, or does not give enough information to decide. Write each verdict on its own line as 'Claim N: SUPPORTED', 'Claim N: CONTRADICTED' or 'Claim N: NOT ENOUGH INFO'. For each verdict, cite the paper and the specific result behind it.

seeds.text: Foxk2 regulates autophagy genes in muscle cells and fibroblast cells.
rationale: Here, we identify Foxk proteins (Foxk1 and Foxk2) as transcriptional repressors of autophagy in muscle cells and fibroblasts.
Foxk1/2 specifically recruits Sin3A-HDAC complexes to restrict acetylation of histone H4 and expression of critical autophagy genes.

seeds.text: Tirasemtiv has no effect on fast-twitch muscle.
rationale: We developed a small-molecule fast-skeletal-troponin activator, CK-2017357, as a means to increase muscle strength by amplifying the response of muscle when neural input is otherwise diminished secondary to neuromuscular disease.
Binding selectively to the fast-skeletal-troponin complex, CK-2017357 slows the rate of calcium release from troponin C and sensitizes muscle to calcium.

claim_2_verdict.description: Claim 2 is supported by the evidence
claim_2_verdict.claim: Foxk2 regulates autophagy genes in muscle cells and fibroblast cells.

claim_1_verdict.description: Claim 1 is contradicted by the evidence
claim_1_verdict.claim: Tirasemtiv has no effect on fast-twitch muscle.

claim_1_flipped.description: Claim 1 called supported, but Paper B contradicts it

claim_2_flipped.description: Claim 2 called contradicted, but Paper A supports it

tool_result.alt_conclusion: Taken together, these results contradict the claim that foxk2 regulates autophagy genes in muscle cells and fibroblast cells.

key_findings.value: Verified: Paper A contradicts Claim 2 (Foxk2 regulates autophagy genes in muscle cells and fibroblast cells.)
key_findings.description: Flips the supported claim to contradicted

sources.value: Paper A is the evidence for Claim 1 and Paper B is the evidence for Claim 2.
sources.description: Swaps which paper backs which claim

conclusions.value: Final verdicts: Claim 1: CONTRADICTED. Claim 2: CONTRADICTED.
conclusions.description: Both claims contradicted, erasing the support
